about_gallery_body: Family, friends and dogs — all part of Cato by Cato.
about_story_body: We did not start with a business plan. We started with food. With travel. With tasting and bringing things home — quite literally. The bags on the ceiling, the banknotes on the line, the herbs from our own garden — these are not decorations. They are who we are. Cato by Cato is the place you do not look for. You find it. And once you have found it, you come back.
about_story_pullquote: We did not start with a business plan. We started with food.
about_travel_body: A different country, a different flavour, a different memory every month. Cato shares them here.
catering_cta_body: We will arrange it together on WhatsApp.
catering_note: No rush — we will work it out together.
catering_what_body: Need a large portion of one topping for a party, company lunch or event? Order in bulk and pick it up at the restaurant. No fuss, no forms — just send us a message.
catering_what_heading: A big group? We have you covered.
contact_instagram_heading: Follow us on Instagram for the daily menu.
garden_brand_note: GardenbyCato — soon to be its own brand.
garden_coming_body: We are working on the next step — fresh produce from our own garden, available to buy. Leave your email address and we will let you know.
garden_coming_heading: Coming soon: fresh from our garden
garden_hero_sub: It all started with a garden.
garden_origin_body: It started with horses and a stable. Then came the vegetable gardens — tomatoes, peppers, courgettes and herbs. More and more, year after year. Now almost everything on your plate comes straight from our own land. Not because it is trendy. Simply because it tastes better.
home_about_body: Cato by Cato is no ordinary restaurant. It is a place you do not look for — you find it. Behind the counter is the woman who keeps everything running. In the kitchen is Cato, who travelled the world and brought its flavours home. Their daughter is here too. A family business in every sense.
home_catering_body: A party, company lunch or simply a big appetite? Order in bulk and pick it up at the restaurant — no fuss, just send us a message.
home_garden_body: Almost everything you eat comes from our own garden. Not as a marketing story — simply because that is how it is.
home_restaurant_body: Choose your base. Choose your topping. Choose your size. Different every day, always fresh and in season.

restaurant_step1_body: A different base every day. Rice, grains or vegetables — freshly prepared, never left over from yesterday.
restaurant_step2_body: The topping of the day is on our Instagram stories. Something different every day, depending on what is fresh.
restaurant_step3_body: Small, medium or large. Stay and take your time, or take it away — it is up to you.
